Former cemeteries in Singapore.fact: Built in 1969, this is the Ying Fo Fui Kun (应和会馆) Cemetery, better called the Hakka Cemetery. The beginnings of the Hakka Cemetery trace back to 1822, when the first influx of migrants from the Guandong province set up the Ying Fo Fui Kun clan at Telok Ayer street.
